faqs.a:
Upon the filing of the plans, preliminary estimate of cost and plat, the council shall
               examine the same; and if the plans, estimate and plat are found to be satisfactory,
               the council shall make a provisional order by resolution to the effect that such project
               shall be acquired or improved, or both acquired and improved.
(Code 1981, § 27-16; Ord. No. 551, § 8(G), 5-14-1964; Ord. No. 766, § 3, 6-16-1969)
